title: ci(scaffold-e2e): give the image run an explicit database (Refs #30120)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:scaffold-e2e 的镜像启动步骤多传一个显式数据库地址(SQLite 文件)。
- 为什么改:#30120 之后官方镜像缺少显式数据库地址就拒绝启动,这一步会变红。
- 风险与回滚:只加一个环境变量;今天镜像不读它,零行为变化;回滚即删这一行。
- 先看:`.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml` 中 "Docker build and run (scaffolded Dockerfile)" 步骤的 docker run。
- 两分钟验证:看本 PR 的 scaffold-e2e 检查,预期绿色、容器照常报健康。
- 需要你做的:这是受管路径(.github/workflows),请 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 批准;之后由席位在 #30120 主 PR 之前落地。

## What changes

One line in `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml`, step "Docker build and run (scaffolded Dockerfile)": the `docker run -d --name e2e ...` call gains `-e OS_DATABASE_URL="file:/tmp/e2e.db"` before the two secret lines.

Why: ruling A3 on #30120 makes the official image refuse to start unless `OS_DATABASE_URL`, `OS_AUTH_SECRET` and `OS_SECRET_KEY` are all set explicitly (an explicit `file:` URL passes). This step sets only the two secrets, so once the #30120 main PR lands, its scaffold-e2e job goes red. The step only probes health, so an explicit SQLite file inside the container is enough. Until #30120 lands the variable is simply unused, so this PR is safe to land first; it must land before or together with the #30120 main PR.
